description: Offers the seller less than the asking price for an item on agentPickup's marketplace, in the person's conversation with them. If the seller has set a lowest price and the offer reaches it, it's accepted on the spot and the item is reserved for the person to pay on Stripe's page; otherwise the seller accepts, counters or declines (within 24 hours). Up to 3 offers on an item a day. Offer only the amount the person chose. Needs sign-in.

message.description: Anything the person wants to say with it, in their words.
